notes.title: New languages are coming!
notes.notes:
We are almost done with the Game's localization, and we will soon be able to test all the languages.

Guild of Ascension will be available in : English / French / Spanish / Portuguese / German / Japanese / Chinese (simplified and traditional).
So I'm sure you're gonna find the languages your are the most comfortable with to enjoy the game :D


The localization is a long process, and we will need to test it a lot to make sure everything works as indented, but we are very happy to offer the game in all those languages :)

notes.title: End of the Beta-Test
notes.notes:
The Beta-Test session is now over! 

Thanks to everyone who took the time to play the game and give us feedbacks!
We already implement a lot of changes based on your comments, and planned to add a lot more before the release :)

Thank you again, 
and don't forget to wishlist the game if you didn't :D

notes.title: The first wave of Guild of Ascension Beta begins today
notes.notes:
Thanks for having been so many to pre-register to our Beta-Test session!

Today is the big day, and we will randomly pick a hundred people who will have access to Guild of Ascension Beta. A feedback form will be available directly in the game menu, we hope you'll use it ;)

A second wave is coming next week. We will pick another hundred players and if you already pre-registered you're still participating.

Pre-registration is still open until May 18th!

notes.title: Are you ready to test Guild of Ascension?
notes.notes:
We are already in May, and the release is getting closer.../o/ 

That's why we need you for a[b] Beta-Testing session[/b]! From [b]May 11th to 24th[/b], give us your feedback on everything in the game: Mechanics, Narration, Tutorials, Controls... 

To participate, [u][b]pre-register now on the store page[/b][/u]. 100 players will be randomly selected the first week, then 100 additionals the second week. A form will be available to send us your comments and observations until May 25th. 

We trust you to help us deliver the best game to players! 
(Don't forget to wishlist the game if you didn't :D )

notes.title: Guild of Ascension is chosen as an Epic MegaGrants Recipient!
notes.notes:
I am so proud to announce today that [b] Guild of Ascension is selected for the Epic MegaGrants program[/b], which reward Unreal Engine users. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949002/fce3ed9d7380219d09f2f7135874fc132ba4618e.jpg[/img]

This grant is such good news! I'll use it to polish the game ([b]visual effects and environments[/b]), and add some new pieces to the [b]soundtrack.[/b]
Having worked for a long time at big companies, I chose [b]Unreal Engine[/b] because the programming language and tools were close to what I was used to. With this engine, it would be much easier to achieve what I had in mind.

Hope you'll like these improvements, don't forget to [b]wishlist the game! [/b] :)

notes.title: You got Powers!
notes.notes:
Our combat system just got a big extension, the new [b]Powers[/b] system!

To extended the move set of our characters and increase the depth of our combat system I implemented a new way to do special strong attacks. 

Now your characters move set is composed of 3 basic attacks, which you can use to gather [b]Power Point[/b], and store up to 4 at a time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949002/a1e85cd732817b205e9ff7b263ad17c24d80715a.gif[/img]



During the combat, you can Hold [b]lb[/b] to switch from you 3 basic attacks, to your 3 [b]Powers[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949002/83e60de57e53f63b1a63076763193cde648269be.gif[/img]



If you have enough Power Point, you can then start your [b]Powers[/b] and inflicts very big damages to a enemy or a group! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949002/4ddec077d63ca7c3255bb094fb976674983c5eea.gif[/img]



Each weapon at the shop come with a specific set of 3 [b]Powers[/b], find the weapon that fit your playstyle the most!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949002/2becc9e4ea5f90e626d04d370bd1072bdc695b42.png[/img]

notes.title: Join the Guild!
notes.notes:
A lot of [b]progress[/b] has been made on the game in the past month, and the [b]First floor[/b] of the [b]Tower[/b] is shaping up nicely. 

We added [b]Duel [/b](where you force you to fight with only one of your 2 Characters), [b]hard encounter[/b] (more challenge, but more rewards), news [b]enemies types[/b], more variety in the [b]map generation[/b], and a [b]new camp[/b] where you can cook food within the Tower ... 


With all of that changes, we toughs it was time to get new [b]Guild Members[/b], and ask them what they think about it ːsteamhappyː
So from now on, you can join us in our website, and register to a special list as [b]Guild Members[/b]! 
👉[url=https://www.guildofascension.com/jointheguild]https://www.guildofascension.com/jointheguild[/url] 👈

When a new build will be ready, we will select from our [b]Guild Members[/b] and send access code to them, all we ask in exchange is your honest opinion ːsteamhappyː


I hope to see you there.
